title: Rollup v59 breaks application logic
body:
Hi

Rollup v59+ removes function calls from object literals that are used by external code.

I have created small piece of code to reproduce the problem.
[Rollup v59](https://rollupjs.org/repl?version=0.59.4&)

And in v58 this is working correctly [LINK](https://rollupjs.org/repl?version=0.58.2&)

See how valid code gets removed inside `componentAdded` method
